Continue building your tech skills anytime, anywhere with Codecademy Go — now with a more personalized user experience. The Codecademy Go mobile app helps you review, practice, and stay on track to meet your goals, no matter how busy your life gets. With a brand-new UX, it’s easier than ever to get started and continue your growth.  

“Taking a few minutes a day to reinforce the underlying concepts has been an easy way to remember them, even on days when I’m not coding.” — Chance N., Codecademy Go Learner 

“Comparing it to all of the other coding apps I have tried this one is best at bringing together learning, practicing, and practicality via articles into one place.” — Sean M., Codecademy Go Learner 

NEW FEATURES 

• Streamlined onboarding to help you get started fast 
• Easier course enrollment — jump in with one tap 
• Personalized course recommendations tailored to your interests 
• Learners can upgrade their plan in-app to continue learning without interruption

ALSO INCLUDED 
 • Discover a new way to practice coding syntax 
 • Remember more with daily flash cards you can skim on the go 
 • Review anywhere — no desktop required 
 • Learn how to apply your skills with real-world tips from industry pros 
 • Track your progress and maintain your streaks 

WHAT CAN I LEARN? 

• AI and Machine Learning 
• Web Development 
• Data Science 
• Computer Science 
• HTML & CSS 
• Python
• JavaScript 
• SQL 
• And more
